newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Sept 6.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Friday:
* Retailers had mixed results during August.
* Shares of Campbell Soup Co hit record high on news of layoffs, acquisition and stock buyback.
* Talks between Detroit's Big Three and the United Automobile Workers are focusing on a landmark proposal to resolve differences over outside suppliers.
* Insurance companies are selling policies over the Internet.
* Drop in auto sales hints at a weak second half of the year.
* Analysts are betting National Semiconductor Corp has bottomed out.
* Dow Jones Industrial Average falls 49.94 to 5,606.96 on a strong employment report.
* Americans are giving President Bill Clinton credit for a turnaround in the economy.
* McDonnell Douglas Corp wins $1.3 billion order from Deutsche Lufthansa AG.
* Retailer Sharper Image Corp seeks a new image.
* Pressure from the Church of Scientology led to shutdown of a well-known Internet address service based in Finland.
